_note: Devlog, news and patch notes for the website (Home) and the launcher. Newest first. type: devlog | news | patch (patch entries carry a version). The lead adds one entry every build; tools/release/make_release.py --version X --patch-notes "line; line" adds the patch entry for you. After editing by hand run: python tools/release/make_release.py --news-only (rewrites news.js for file:// viewing and the launcher's fallback copy).

news.title: Act III is written
news.summary: The story reaches its midpoint: the Chapter comes home to the Royal Capital, and the capital is not the city it was.
body: A whole act set in the capital you know, with new missions, new faces and old friends.
New enemies and bosses with phase changes and full boss introductions.
Side quests for the townsfolk caught up in it.

news.title: Tank, healer, damage
news.summary: Grimoires now grow into roles: the Guardian path in Weapon Arts makes a tank, the healer path in Support makes a real healer.
body: Tanks: a taunt, the Bulwark stance and Shield Wall, with threat that the enemies actually follow.
Healers: a single heal, a heal over time, a cleanse and a revive, named for each of the seven elements.
Your AI crew fill whatever role your group is missing.
No classes: your grimoire is your class. The wiki now has a build planner and ready builds for fifteen playstyles.

news.title: Act II: Whisperwood and the Saltglass Coast
news.summary: Two new regions: an ancient forest where a fairy tale is writing itself again, and a cliff-town coast with a library under the sea.
body: Whisperwood: glowing fungi, fae ruins, shifting paths and the wardens of the Antler Hollow.
The Saltglass Coast: Lanternreach, the lighthouse, the Sunken Library and what sleeps in the bay.
Three new crew members join along the way.

news.title: Act I: the Hollowmere Farmlands
news.summary: The first act is complete, from the black well at Millbrook to the harvest festival.
body: Story missions under the farm, in the quarry, in the under-market fighting pits and in the north field.
Bram and Sabine join the Chapter, and your first key choice changes how the act ends.
Side quests, a region lore cinematic and the act finale.

news.title: Play with friends
news.summary: Co-op groundwork: room codes, chat, pings and emotes work in a test arena. Hosting from the game and friends in missions come next.
body: Loot is personal: every player rolls their own drops.
Enemies grow tougher for every extra real player in the group.

news.title: The first loop: from the Codex Night to the crypt
news.summary: Make your apprentice, receive your grimoire, walk into the Royal Capital and take your first mission from the board.
body: The grimoire ceremony cinematic and the Soul Trial.
The Royal Capital with its shops, crafting court, tavern and the Chapter's sky-ship.
The Grimoire Crypt and the Fallen Keep, loot in five rarities, and the first Windows build for friends.

news.title: Preview 0.1.0: the first pages
news.summary: The first preview build for testers.
body: Character creator, the Soul Trial and the Codex Night ceremony that binds your grimoire.
The Royal Capital: the Codex Hall, shops, the crafting court, the tavern, the under-market and the Chapter's sky-ship.
Crafting at the forge, alchemy table, rune bench, cooking fire, tailor and bookbinder.
Missions and dungeons on Normal, Hard and Mythic, with personal loot in five rarities.
Spell trees for all seven elements, weapon mastery and element reactions.
Co-op test arena with room codes (missions next).

news.title: The book chose you
news.summary: Where it started: the Soul Trial, the shadow duel and twenty-eight signature spells, one for each element and fighting style.
body: A familiar asks you eight questions; your answers write your grimoire.
You fight your own shadow in a mirror arena before the book binds itself.
